name: Wachtendonk (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wachtendonk (a red fleur-de-lis above a red castle on yellow).
history: By deeds of the Regierungspräsident in Düsseldorf of 30 October 1971 and 7 June 1972 the municipality of Wachtendonk was granted the right to bear its flag.

features.role: Wachtendonk arms — fleur-de-lis and castle on yellow
